question_en: List the names of all presidents born in Virginia.
question_th: หารายชื่อของประธานาธิบดีทุกคนที่เกิดในเวอร์จิเนีย
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE StateBorn = 'Virginia';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE StateBorn = 'Virginia';

question_en: Show the name and birth year of presidents born after 1850, newest first.
question_th: แสดงชื่อและปีเกิดของประธานาธิบดีที่เกิดหลังปี 1850 แสดงปีล่าสุดก่อน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President WHERE YearBorn > 1850 ORDER BY YearBorn DESC;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President WHERE YearBorn > 1850 ORDER BY YearBorn DESC;
v13_rationale: 'newest first' gives no tiebreak: rows tied on YearBorn may come in any order

question_en: List the distinct states in which presidents were born.
question_th: หารายชื่อที่ไม่ซ้ำกันของรัฐเกิดของประธานาธิบดี
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT StateBorn FROM President;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT StateBorn FROM President;

question_en: Show the five earliest-born presidents with their birth years (break ties by name).
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดี 5 คนที่เกิดนานสุด พร้อมปีเกิด (ถ้าปีเกิดเท่ากันให้เรียงตามชื่อ)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President ORDER BY YearBorn ASC, PresidentName ASC LIMIT 5;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President ORDER BY YearBorn ASC, PresidentName ASC LIMIT 5;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President ORDER BY YearBorn ASC, PresidentName DESC LIMIT 5"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President ORDER BY YearBorn ASC, PresidentName DESC LIMIT 5"]
v13_rationale: 'break ties by name' gives no direction: both name directions accepted

question_en: List presidents whose party is 'Federalist'.
question_th: หารายชื่อของประธานาธิบดีที่สังกัดพรรค Federalist
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PartyName = 'Federalist';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PartyName = 'Federalist';

question_en: List presidents whose name starts with 'J'.
question_th: หารายชื่อของประธานาธิบดีทุกคนที่ขึ้นต้นด้วยตัวอักษร "J"
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PresidentName LIKE 'J%';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PresidentName LIKE 'J%';

question_en: From the marriage records, list spouse names where the marriage status is 'Widowed'.
question_th: จากข้อมูลการสมรสให้หาขื่อคู่สมรสที่มีสถานะการสมรสเป็นหม้าย
gold_sql_draft: SELECT SpouseName FROM PresidentMarriage WHERE MarriageStatus = 'Widowed';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT SpouseName FROM PresidentMarriage WHERE MarriageStatus = 'Widowed';

question_en: List presidencies (president name and start year) that began in the nineteenth century.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดี และปีเริ่มต้นดำรงตำแหน่งช่วงศตวรรษที่ 19
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearHolding FROM PresidentHolding WHERE YearHolding BETWEEN 1800 AND 1899;
notes: | convention: ศตวรรษที่ 19 ≡ 1800-1899 (colloquial); gold uses BETWEEN 1800 AND 1899
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName, YearHolding FROM PresidentHolding WHERE YearHolding BETWEEN 1800 AND 1899;

question_en: Show all orders shipped to customers in Tokyo (OrderID, ProductName, CustomerCity).
question_th: แสดงรายการคำสั่งซื้อทั้งหมดที่ส่งให้กับลูกค้าในโตเกียว (OrderID, ProductName, CustomerCity)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, CustomerCity FROM Ecommerce WHERE CustomerCity = 'Tokyo';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, CustomerCity FROM Ecommerce WHERE CustomerCity = 'Tokyo';

question_en: List orders with a final price above 1000, showing OrderID, ProductName, and FinalPrice.
question_th: แสดงรายการคำสั่งซื้อที่ราคาสุดท้ายมากกว่า 1000 ให้แสดง OrderID, ProductName, และ FinalPrice
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, FinalPrice FROM Ecommerce WHERE FinalPrice > 1000;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, FinalPrice FROM Ecommerce WHERE FinalPrice > 1000;

question_en: List the distinct product categories.
question_th: แสดงรายการหมวดหมู่สินค้าที่ไม่ซ้ำกัน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM Ecommerce;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM Ecommerce;

question_en: Show the 10 most recent orders by order date, breaking ties by OrderID (OrderID, OrderDate).
question_th: แสดงรายการสั่งซื้อ 10 รายการล่าสุดตามวันที่ ถ้าวันที่เท่ากันให้เรียงตาม OrderID (OrderID, OrderDate)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, OrderDate FROM Ecommerce ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID DESC LIMIT 10;
notes: AMD1: tiebreak determinism | efficiency: ORDER BY on date at 1M rows
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, OrderDate FROM Ecommerce ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID DESC LIMIT 10;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT OrderID, OrderDate FROM Ecommerce ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID ASC LIMIT 10"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT OrderID, OrderDate FROM Ecommerce ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID ASC LIMIT 10"]
v13_rationale: 'breaking ties by OrderID' / 'เรียงตาม OrderID' gives no direction: both accepted

question_en: List orders paid by 'Credit Card' with quantity of at least 5 (show OrderID, ProductName, Quantity).
question_th: แสดงรายการสั่งซื้อที่จ่ายเงินด้วยบัตรเครดิตและมีจำนวนอย่างน้อย 5 (แสดง OrderID, ProductName, Quantity)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, Quantity FROM Ecommerce WHERE PaymentMethod = 'Credit Card' AND Quantity >= 5;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, Quantity FROM Ecommerce WHERE PaymentMethod = 'Credit Card' AND Quantity >= 5;

question_en: List orders that were neither returned nor exchanged and have a product rating of at least 4.5 (show OrderID, ProductName, ProductRating).
question_th: แสดงรายการคำสั่งซื้อที่ไม่มีการคืนหรือเปลี่ยนสินค้า โดยสินค้ามีเรตติ้งตั้งแต่ 4.5 (แสดง OrderID, ProductName, ProductRating)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, ProductRating FROM Ecommerce WHERE ReturnStatus = 'No Return' AND ProductRating >= 4.5;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, ProductRating FROM Ecommerce WHERE ReturnStatus = 'No Return' AND ProductRating >= 4.5;

question_en: Show orders in the 'Clothing' category placed by female customers (show OrderID, ProductName).
question_th: แสดงคำสั่งซื้อของสินค้าในกลุ่มเครื่องแต่งกายที่สั่งซื้อโดยผู้หญิง (แสดง OrderID, ProductName)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName FROM Ecommerce WHERE Category = 'Clothing' AND CustomerGender = 'Female';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, ProductName FROM Ecommerce WHERE Category = 'Clothing' AND CustomerGender = 'Female';

question_en: List each president together with his spouse's name.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีแต่ละคนพร้อมชื่อคู่สมรส
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, m.SpouseName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT p.PresidentName, m.SpouseName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName;

question_en: Show each president with the years he held office (start and end).
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีพร้อมกับช่วงปีที่ดำรงตำแหน่ง (ปีเริ่มต้น และปีสิ้นสุด)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, h.YearHolding, h.YearEnd FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT p.PresidentName, h.YearHolding, h.YearEnd FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName;

question_en: List presidents who married after first taking office.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่สมรสหลังจากเข้ารับตำแหน่ง
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.MarriageYear > h.YearHolding;
notes: 3-table; ambiguity note: "first" term ‚Äî gold uses any term; instructor to confirm reading
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.MarriageYear > h.YearHolding;

question_en: List vice presidents who themselves later became president.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อรองประธานาธิบดีที่ต่อมาได้เป็นประธานาธิบดี
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT h.VicePresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN PresidentHolding h2 ON h.VicePresidentName = h2.PresidentName WHERE h2.YearHolding >= h.YearHolding;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT h.VicePresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN PresidentHolding h2 ON h.VicePresidentName = h2.PresidentName WHERE h2.YearHolding > h.YearHolding;
v13_rationale: 'later became president' includes same-year succession (Tyler 1841, A. Johnson 1865); '>' -> '>='

question_en: For each presidential marriage, show the president's name, the spouse's name, and the president's party.
question_th: ในการสมรสแต่ละครั้งของประธานาธิบดี ให้แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดี ชื่อคู่สมรส และพรรคที่ประธานาธิบดีสังกัด
gold_sql_draft: SELECT m.PresidentName, m.SpouseName, p.PartyName FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN President p ON m.PresidentName = p.PresidentName;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT m.PresidentName, m.SpouseName, p.PartyName FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN President p ON m.PresidentName = p.PresidentName;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT m.PresidentName, m.SpouseName, p.PartyName FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN President p ON m.PresidentName = p.PresidentName WHERE m.SpouseName <> 'None'"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT m.PresidentName, m.SpouseName, p.PartyName FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN President p ON m.PresidentName = p.PresidentName WHERE m.SpouseName <> 'None'"]
v13_rationale: Buchanan's row is a placeholder ('None', no marriage): 48-row reading also accepted

question_en: List presidents from Virginia who began a term before 1850.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีจากรัฐเวอร์จิเนียที่เริ่มดำรงตำแหน่งก่อนปี 1850
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName WHERE p.StateBorn = 'Virginia' AND h.YearHolding < 1850;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName WHERE p.StateBorn = 'Virginia' AND h.YearHolding < 1850;

question_en: List elections (president, start year, runner-up) where the runner-up was himself a president at some time.
question_th: แสดงรายละเอียดการเลือกตั้ง (ชื่อประธานาธิบดี ปีเริ่มดำรงตำแหน่ง ชื่อผู้ได้คะแนนอันดับที่ 2) ที่ผู้ที่ได้คะแนนอันดับที่ 2 ก็ได้เป็นประธานาธิบดีด้วย
gold_sql_draft: SELECT h.PresidentName, h.YearHolding, h.RunnerUp FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN President p ON h.RunnerUp = p.PresidentName;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT h.PresidentName, h.YearHolding, h.RunnerUp FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN President p ON h.RunnerUp = p.PresidentName;

question_en: For presidents whose spouse was born before the president himself, show the president's name and that spouse's name.
question_th: สำหรับประธานาธิบดีที่คู่สมรสเกิดก่อนตัวประธานาธิบดีเอง ให้แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดีและชื่อคู่สมรสคนนั้น
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, m.SpouseName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date) < p.YearBorn;
notes: date vs year comparison ‚Äî deliberate subtlety
gold_sql_v12: SELECT p.PresidentName, m.SpouseName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date) < p.YearBorn;

question_en: List presidents who never served as vice president.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่ไม่เคยดำรงตำแหน่งรองประธานาธิบดี
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName FROM President p LEFT JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.VicePresidentName WHERE h.VicePresidentName IS NULL;
notes: AMD1: เดิม no-recorded-marriage ให้คำตอบว่าง (45/45 มีบันทึก) — เปลี่ยนเป้า anti-join, ทักษะเดิม
gold_sql_v12: SELECT p.PresidentName FROM President p LEFT JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.VicePresidentName WHERE h.VicePresidentName IS NULL;

question_en: List presidents who held office in two non-consecutive periods (two records with different start years).
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่ดำรงตำแหน่งครั้งที่สองแบบวาระการดำรงตำแหน่งไม่ต่อกัน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT h1.PresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h1 JOIN PresidentHolding h2 ON h1.PresidentName = h2.PresidentName AND h1.YearHolding < h2.YearHolding WHERE h1.YearEnd < h2.YearHolding;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT h1.PresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h1 JOIN PresidentHolding h2 ON h1.PresidentName = h2.PresidentName AND h1.YearHolding < h2.YearHolding WHERE h1.YearEnd < h2.YearHolding;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT PresidentName FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT YearHolding) >= 2"]
v13_rationale: EN parenthetical defines the condition as two records with different start years: literal 4-row reading also accepted in EN

question_en: List customers (CustomerID) who have placed orders in at least two different categories.
question_th: แสดง CustomerID ของผู้ที่สั่งสินค้าอย่างน้อยสองหมวดสินค้าที่ต่างกัน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT e1.CustomerID FROM Ecommerce e1 JOIN Ecommerce e2 ON e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.Category <> e2.Category;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT e1.CustomerID FROM Ecommerce e1 JOIN Ecommerce e2 ON e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.Category <> e2.Category;

question_en: Find pairs of orders placed by the same customer on the same date (show CustomerID, both OrderIDs).
question_th: แสดง CustomerID และ OrderID ที่มีสองคำสั่งซื้อโดยลุกค้าคนเดียวกันภายในวันเดียวกัน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT e1.CustomerID, e1.OrderID, e2.OrderID FROM Ecommerce e1 JOIN Ecommerce e2 ON e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.OrderDate = e2.OrderDate AND e1.OrderID < e2.OrderID;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT e1.CustomerID, e1.OrderID, e2.OrderID FROM Ecommerce e1 JOIN Ecommerce e2 ON e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.OrderDate = e2.OrderDate AND e1.OrderID < e2.OrderID;
v13_rationale: gold returns 0 rows on the run DB: item excluded from primary analysis (n=59); reported with Q27 as sensitivity

question_en: List president-and-vice-president pairs who were born in the same state.
question_th: แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดีและรองประธานาธิบดีคู่กันที่ทั้งคู่เกิดในรัฐเดียวกัน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT h.PresidentName, h.VicePresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN President p1 ON h.PresidentName = p1.PresidentName JOIN President p2 ON h.VicePresidentName = p2.PresidentName WHERE p1.StateBorn = p2.StateBorn;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT h.PresidentName, h.VicePresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN President p1 ON h.PresidentName = p1.PresidentName JOIN President p2 ON h.VicePresidentName = p2.PresidentName WHERE p1.StateBorn = p2.StateBorn;

question_en: Show the marriage status of every president who began a term in the twentieth century (show president name and marriage status).
question_th: แสดงสถานะการสมรสของประธานาธิบดีทุกคนที่เริ่มดำรงตำแหน่งในศตวรรษที่ 20 (แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดีและสถานะการสมรส)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT m.PresidentName, m.MarriageStatus FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN PresidentHolding h ON m.PresidentName = h.PresidentName WHERE h.YearHolding BETWEEN 1900 AND 1999;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DISTINCT m.PresidentName, m.MarriageStatus FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN PresidentHolding h ON m.PresidentName = h.PresidentName WHERE h.YearHolding BETWEEN 1900 AND 1999;

question_en: List Democratic-Republican presidents whose marriage record shows status 'Widowed'.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีของพรรค Democratic-Republican ที่มีสถานะของการสมรสเป็นหม้าย
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE p.PartyName = 'Democratic-Republican' AND m.MarriageStatus = 'Widowed';
gold_sql_v12: SELECT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE p.PartyName = 'Democratic-Republican' AND m.MarriageStatus = 'Widowed';

question_en: Count the number of presidents in each party.
question_th: นับจำนวนของประธานาธิบดีของแต่ละพรรค
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PartyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY PartyName;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PartyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY PartyName;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT pa.PartyName, COUNT(p.PresidentName) AS n FROM Party pa LEFT JOIN President p ON p.PartyName = pa.PartyName GROUP BY pa.PartyName"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT pa.PartyName, COUNT(p.PresidentName) AS n FROM Party pa LEFT JOIN President p ON p.PartyName = pa.PartyName GROUP BY pa.PartyName"]
v13_rationale: 'each party' may include parties with no president (count 0): 9-row reading also accepted

question_en: Which state has produced the most presidents? Show the state and the count (break ties alphabetically).
question_th: รัฐใดให้กำเนิดประธานาธิบดีมากที่สุด แสดงชื่อรัฐและจำนวน (ถ้าเท่ากันให้เรียงตามตัวอักษร)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT StateBorn, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY StateBorn ORDER BY n DESC, StateBorn ASC LIMIT 1;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT StateBorn, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY StateBorn ORDER BY n DESC, StateBorn ASC LIMIT 1;

question_en: What is the average length in years of a presidential term?
question_th: แสดงระยะเวลาดำรงตำแหน่งโดยฉลี่ยของประธานาธิบดี
gold_sql_draft: SELECT AVG(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS avg_years FROM PresidentHolding;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT AVG(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS avg_years FROM PresidentHolding;
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT AVG(t) AS avg_years FROM (SELECT SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS t FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName) s"]
v13_rationale: TH asks average time in office of presidents: per-president average also accepted in TH

question_en: List presidents who have more than one marriage record.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่สมรสมากกว่า 1 ครั้ง
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM PresidentMarriage GROUP BY PresidentName HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName FROM PresidentMarriage GROUP BY PresidentName HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question_en: For each president in the holding table, show his earliest start year and latest end year.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่อยู่ในตาราง President_Holding พร้อมกับปีของการเริ่มตำแหน่งที่เก่าสุดและปีสิ้นสุดการดำรงตำแหน่งล่าสุด
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, MIN(YearHolding) AS first_start, MAX(YearEnd) AS last_end FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName, MIN(YearHolding) AS first_start, MAX(YearEnd) AS last_end FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName;

question_en: Compute the total revenue of each product category, highest first.
question_th: คำนวณรายรับรวมของสินค้าแต่ละหมวดให้เรียงลำดับค่าจากมากไปน้อย
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Category, SUM(Revenue) AS total_revenue FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT Category, SUM(Revenue) AS total_revenue FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question_en: What is the average customer satisfaction per membership tier?
question_th: แสดงจำนวนเฉลี่ยของค่าความพึงพอใจของลูกค้าแต่ละระดับ
gold_sql_draft: SELECT MembershipTier, AVG(CustomerSatisfaction) AS avg_sat FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MembershipTier;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT MembershipTier, AVG(CustomerSatisfaction) AS avg_sat FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MembershipTier;

question_en: Show the top 5 customer cities by number of orders (show city and order count; break ties alphabetically).
question_th: แสดง 5 เมืองของลูกค้าที่มีคำสั่งซื้อมากที่สุด (แสดงชื่อเมืองและจำนวนคำสั่งซื้อ; ถ้าเท่ากันให้เรียงตามตัวอักษร)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT CustomerCity, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerCity ORDER BY n DESC, CustomerCity ASC LIMIT 5;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT CustomerCity, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerCity ORDER BY n DESC, CustomerCity ASC LIMIT 5;

question_en: Show monthly total revenue for 2024 in month order.
question_th: แสดงผลรวมของรายรับแต่ละเดือนในปี 2024
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate::date) AS month, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate::date) AS month, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
v13_rationale: month encoding not fixed (date, timestamp, YYYY-MM, month number in 2024); TH does not ask month order

question_en: List categories whose average product rating exceeds 3 (show category and average rating).
question_th: แสดงหมวดหมู่สินค้าที่มีเรตติ้งเฉลี่ยเกิน 3 (แสดงหมวดหมู่และเรตติ้งเฉลี่ย)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Category, AVG(ProductRating) AS avg_rating FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category HAVING AVG(ProductRating) > 3;
notes: AMD1: threshold 4→3 (ค่าเฉลี่ยจริง ~3.0-3.1; ที่ 4 คำตอบว่าง)
gold_sql_v12: SELECT Category, AVG(ProductRating) AS avg_rating FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category HAVING AVG(ProductRating) > 3;

question_en: For marketing channels with more than 100 orders, show the channel and its total revenue.
question_th: แสดงช่องทางการตลาดและรายได้รวมของแต่ละช่องทางการตลาดที่มีจำนวนคำสั่งซื้อมากกว่า 100 คำสั่งซื้อ
gold_sql_draft: SELECT MarketingChannel, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MarketingChannel HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;
notes: threshold rescales with dataset; instructor confirm
gold_sql_v12: SELECT MarketingChannel, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MarketingChannel HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;

question_en: For each brand, count returned-or-exchanged orders versus 'No Return' orders.
question_th: นับจำนวนการคืนหรือการเปลี่ยนสินค้าของคำสั่งซื้อเทียบกับคำสั่งซื้อที่ไม่มีการคืนสินค้าแยกตามยี่ห้อ
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Brand, SUM(CASE WHEN ReturnStatus <> 'No Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned, SUM(CASE WHEN ReturnStatus = 'No Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kept FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Brand;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT Brand, SUM(CASE WHEN ReturnStatus = 'No Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kept, SUM(CASE WHEN ReturnStatus <> 'No Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Brand;
v13_rationale: gold column order reversed to follow the question (returned/exchanged first); grading effect covered by G1

question_en: Show the maximum order revenue for each payment method.
question_th: แสดงรายรับที่มากที่สุดของคำสั่งซื้อแยกตามประเภภของการจ่ายเงิน
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PaymentMethod, MAX(Revenue) AS max_rev FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY PaymentMethod;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PaymentMethod, MAX(Revenue) AS max_rev FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY PaymentMethod;

question_en: List parties that have had at least three presidents (show party and president count).
question_th: แสดงชื่อพรรคที่มีประธานาธิบดีตั้งแต่ 3 คน (แสดงชื่อพรรคและจำนวนประธานาธิบดี)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PartyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY PartyName HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PartyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY PartyName HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

question_en: Show the average delivery days per region, slowest region first.
question_th: แสดงค่าเฉลี่ยของระยะเวลาส่งสินค้าแยกตามภาค เรียงลำดับจากช้าสุดไปเร็วสุด
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Region, AVG(DeliveryDays) AS avg_days FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Region ORDER BY avg_days DESC;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT Region, AVG(DeliveryDays) AS avg_days FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Region ORDER BY avg_days DESC;

question_en: List presidents whose term length exceeded the average term length (show president and term length).
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่มีระยะเวลาดำรงตำแหน่งเกินกว่าค่าเฉลี่ย (แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดีและระยะเวลาดำรงตำแหน่ง)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len FROM PresidentHolding WHERE YearEnd - YearHolding > (SELECT AVG(YearEnd - YearHolding) FROM PresidentHolding);
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len FROM PresidentHolding WHERE YearEnd - YearHolding > (SELECT AVG(YearEnd - YearHolding) FROM PresidentHolding);
alt_gold_th: ["WITH t AS (SELECT PresidentName, SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS tenure FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName) SELECT PresidentName, tenure FROM t WHERE tenure > (SELECT AVG(tenure) FROM t)"]
v13_rationale: TH 'ระยะเวลาดำรงตำแหน่ง' reads as a president's time in office: per-president tenure also accepted in TH

question_en: For each party, show the earliest-born president and his birth year (break ties by name).
question_th: สำหรับแต่ละพรรค แสดงประธานาธิบดีที่เกิดก่อนใครที่สุดของพรรคนั้นพร้อมปีเกิด (ถ้าปีเกิดเท่ากันให้เอาชื่อที่มาก่อนตามตัวอักษร)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PartyName, PresidentName, YearBorn FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PartyName ORDER BY YearBorn, PresidentName) AS rn FROM President p) t WHERE rn = 1;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PartyName, PresidentName, YearBorn FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PartyName ORDER BY YearBorn, PresidentName) AS rn FROM President p) t WHERE rn = 1;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT PartyName, PresidentName, YearBorn FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PartyName ORDER BY YearBorn, PresidentName DESC) AS rn FROM President p) t WHERE rn = 1"]
v13_rationale: EN 'break ties by name' gives no direction (TH does): reversed direction accepted in EN

question_en: List presidents who never appear as a runner-up in any election record.
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อประธานาธิบดีที่ไม่เคยมีคะแนนการเลือกตั้งมาเป็นอันดับสอง
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PresidentName NOT IN (SELECT RunnerUp FROM PresidentHolding WHERE RunnerUp IS NOT NULL AND RunnerUp <> 'None');
notes: NOT IN with NULL guard ‚Äî deliberate trap
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PresidentName NOT IN (SELECT RunnerUp FROM PresidentHolding WHERE RunnerUp IS NOT NULL AND RunnerUp <> 'None');

question_en: Rank all presidencies by term length, longest first (show president, term length, and rank).
question_th: แสดงอันดับประธานาธิบดีตามระยะเวลาดำรงตำแหน่ง นานสุดก่อน (แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดี ระยะเวลาดำรงตำแหน่ง และอันดับ)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YearEnd - YearHolding DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding ORDER BY term_len DESC;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YearEnd - YearHolding DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YearEnd - YearHolding DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding ORDER BY term_len DESC"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YearEnd - YearHolding DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding ORDER BY term_len DESC", "SELECT PresidentName, SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS tenure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName ORDER BY tenure DESC", "SELECT PresidentName, SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS tenure, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName ORDER BY tenure DESC"]
v13_rationale: 'longest first' now enforced (ties free); RANK or DENSE_RANK; TH ranks presidents: per-president reading accepted in TH

question_en: Show the three presidents with the largest age gap between president and spouse (show president and age gap in years; break ties by president name).
question_th: แสดงประธานาธิบดี 3 คนที่อายุห่างจากคู่สมรสมากที่สุด (แสดงชื่อประธานาธิบดีและผลต่างอายุเป็นปี; ถ้าเท่ากันให้เรียงตามชื่อประธานาธิบดี)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, ABS(p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date)) AS gap FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.SpouseBirthDay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap DESC, p.PresidentName ASC LIMIT 3;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT p.PresidentName, p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date) AS gap FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName ORDER BY ABS(p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date)) DESC, p.PresidentName ASC LIMIT 3;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT p.PresidentName, ABS(p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date)) AS gap FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.SpouseBirthDay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap DESC, p.PresidentName DESC LIMIT 3"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT p.PresidentName, ABS(p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date)) AS gap FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.SpouseBirthDay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap DESC, p.PresidentName DESC LIMIT 3"]
v13_rationale: NULL spouse birth date (Buchanan, no spouse) ranked first by NULLS FIRST; gap shown signed: corrected gold excludes NULL, gap sign not graded, name tiebreak direction open

question_en: For each customer, show only their most recent order, breaking date ties by OrderID (CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate).
question_th: สำหรับลูกค้าแต่ละราย แสดงเฉพาะคำสั่งซื้อล่าสุด ถ้าวันที่เท่ากันให้ใช้ OrderID มากสุด (CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate FROM (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce e) t WHERE rn = 1;
notes: AMD1: tiebreak determinism | window at scale
gold_sql_v12: SELECT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate FROM (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce e) t WHERE rn = 1;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate FROM (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID ASC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce e) t WHERE rn = 1"]
v13_rationale: EN 'breaking date ties by OrderID' gives no direction (TH says largest): reversed direction accepted in EN

question_en: Show cumulative revenue over time ordered by order date.
question_th: แสดงผลรวมสะสมของรายรับตลอดระยะเวลาให้เรียงลำดับตามวันที่ของคำสั่งซื้อ
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderDate, SUM(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS cum_rev FROM Ecommerce ORDER BY OrderDate;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderDate, SUM(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS cum_rev FROM Ecommerce;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT OrderDate, SUM(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS cum_rev FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate ORDER BY OrderDate"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT OrderDate, SUM(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS cum_rev FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate ORDER BY OrderDate"]
v13_rationale: 'ordered by order date' now enforced; 'cumulative revenue over time' per date also accepted

question_en: List orders whose final price is above the average final price of their own category (show OrderID, Category, FinalPrice).
question_th: แสดงรายการคำสั่งซื้อที่มีราคาสุดท้ายเหนือค่าเฉลี่ยของสินค้าในหมวดหมู่ตนเอง (แสดง OrderID, Category, FinalPrice)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, Category, FinalPrice FROM Ecommerce e WHERE FinalPrice > (SELECT AVG(FinalPrice) FROM Ecommerce e2 WHERE e2.Category = e.Category);
gold_sql_v12: SELECT OrderID, Category, FinalPrice FROM Ecommerce e WHERE FinalPrice > (SELECT AVG(FinalPrice) FROM Ecommerce e2 WHERE e2.Category = e.Category);

question_en: Show month-over-month change in total revenue for 2024 (show month, monthly total, and change from previous month).
question_th: แสดงการเปลี่ยนแปลงของรายได้รวมรายเดือนเทียบกับเดือนก่อนหน้าของปี 2024 (แสดงเดือน รายได้รวมของเดือน และผลต่างจากเดือนก่อนหน้า)
gold_sql_draft: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate::date) AS month, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, total, total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change FROM m;
gold_sql_v12: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate::date) AS month, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, total, total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change FROM m;
v13_rationale: month encoding not fixed (date, timestamp, YYYY-MM, month number in 2024)

question_en: For each category, show its top 3 products by total revenue (show product and total revenue; break ties by product name).
question_th: สำหรับแต่ละหมวดสินค้า แสดงสินค้า 3 อันดับแรกตามรายได้รวม (แสดงชื่อสินค้าและรายได้รวม; ถ้าเท่ากันให้เรียงตามชื่อสินค้า)
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Category, ProductName, total FROM (SELECT Category, ProductName, SUM(Revenue) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC, ProductName ASC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category, ProductName) t WHERE rn <= 3;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT Category, ProductName, total FROM (SELECT Category, ProductName, SUM(Revenue) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC, ProductName ASC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category, ProductName) t WHERE rn <= 3;
alt_gold_en: ["SELECT Category, ProductName, total FROM (SELECT Category, ProductName, SUM(Revenue) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC, ProductName DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category, ProductName) t WHERE rn <= 3"]
alt_gold_th: ["SELECT Category, ProductName, total FROM (SELECT Category, ProductName, SUM(Revenue) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC, ProductName DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category, ProductName) t WHERE rn <= 3"]
v13_rationale: 'break ties by product name' gives no direction: both accepted

question_en: List customers whose total spending is above the 95th percentile of customer totals (show CustomerID and total spending).
question_th: แสดงรายชื่อลูกค้าที่มียอดใช้จ่ายรวมสูงกว่าเปอร์เซ็นไทล์ที่ 95 ของยอดรวมลูกค้าทั้งหมด (แสดง CustomerID และยอดใช้จ่ายรวม)
gold_sql_draft: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, total FROM s WHERE total > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) FROM s);
gold_sql_v12: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, total FROM s WHERE total > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) FROM s);
alt_gold_en: ["WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, total FROM s WHERE total > (SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) FROM s)"]
alt_gold_th: ["WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, total FROM s WHERE total > (SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) FROM s)"]
v13_rationale: '95th percentile' has two standard definitions: PERCENTILE_DISC also accepted

question_en: Show each marketing channel's share of total revenue as a percentage.
question_th: แสดงสัดส่วนรายได้จากแต่ละช่องทางการตลาดเป็นร้อยละของรายได้ทั้งหมด
gold_sql_draft: SELECT MarketingChannel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Revenue) / SUM(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MarketingChannel;
gold_sql_v12: SELECT MarketingChannel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Revenue) / SUM(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MarketingChannel;
v13_rationale: gold rounds to 2 dp although the question does not ask: compared at the gold's 2-dp precision

question_en: For each customer with at least two orders, show the number of days between their first and second order (order ties broken by OrderID).
question_th: สำหรับลูกค้าที่มีคำสั่งซื้อตั้งแต่ 2 รายการ แสดงจำนวนวันระหว่างคำสั่งซื้อแรกและครั้งที่สอง (วันที่เท่ากันให้เรียงตาม OrderID)
gold_sql_draft: WITH o AS (SELECT CustomerID, OrderDate::date AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn FROM Ecommerce) SELECT a.CustomerID, (b.d - a.d) AS days_between FROM o a JOIN o b ON a.CustomerID = b.CustomerID AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2;
gold_sql_v12: WITH o AS (SELECT CustomerID, OrderDate::date AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn FROM Ecommerce) SELECT a.CustomerID, (b.d - a.d) AS days_between FROM o a JOIN o b ON a.CustomerID = b.CustomerID AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2;
alt_gold_en: ["WITH o AS (SELECT CustomerID, OrderDate::date AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce) SELECT a.CustomerID, (b.d - a.d) AS days_between FROM o a JOIN o b ON a.CustomerID = b.CustomerID AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2"]
alt_gold_th: ["WITH o AS (SELECT CustomerID, OrderDate::date AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce) SELECT a.CustomerID, (b.d - a.d) AS days_between FROM o a JOIN o b ON a.CustomerID = b.CustomerID AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2"]
v13_rationale: 'order ties broken by OrderID' gives no direction: both accepted

question_en: Using a CTE, count how many presidents were born in each decade.
question_th: ให้ใช้ CTE (Common Table Expression) เพื่อนับจำนวนประธานาธิบดีที่เกิดในแต่ละทศวรรษ
gold_sql_draft: WITH d AS (SELECT PresidentName, (YearBorn / 10) * 10 AS decade FROM President) SELECT decade, COUNT(*) AS n FROM d GROUP BY decade;
gold_sql_v12: WITH d AS (SELECT PresidentName, (YearBorn / 10) * 10 AS decade FROM President) SELECT decade, COUNT(*) AS n FROM d GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade;
v13_rationale: question asks no order: ORDER BY removed, rows unordered; decade encoding (1730, 1730.0, '1730s') not graded

question_en: Show the 7-day moving average of daily total revenue.
question_th: แสดงค่าเฉลี่ยเคลื่อนที่แบบ 7 วัน ของรายได้รวมรายวัน
gold_sql_draft: WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date) SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7 FROM daily;
gold_sql_v12: WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date) SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7 FROM daily;
alt_gold_en: ["WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date), w AS (SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c FROM daily) SELECT d, CASE WHEN c = 7 THEN ma END AS ma7 FROM w", "WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date), w AS (SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c FROM daily) SELECT d, ma AS ma7 FROM w WHERE c = 7"]
alt_gold_th: ["WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date), w AS (SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c FROM daily) SELECT d, CASE WHEN c = 7 THEN ma END AS ma7 FROM w", "WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date), w AS (SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c FROM daily) SELECT d, ma AS ma7 FROM w WHERE c = 7"]
v13_rationale: '7-day moving average' strict definition (undefined for the first 6 days, shown NULL or omitted) also accepted
